Container.Name: ChatGPT-Community
Container.Overview: ChatGPT Community as a single application: no XFCE desktop or taskbar. Includes experimental Remote Mobile Control, persistent credentials and root SSH access to Unraid. Optional Intel/AMD GPU acceleration. Protect the WebUI with a password and keep it on LAN/VPN.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Keep the existing path to preserve login, pairing and SSH keys

Config.Name: GPU
Config.Description: Intel/AMD rendering and encoding; remove this device when the host has no /dev/dri

Config.Name: WebUI username
Config.Description: WebUI basic-auth username, unrelated to your ChatGPT account

Config.Name: WebUI password
Config.Description: Set a strong unique password; blank means no WebUI authentication

Config.Name: Wayland
Config.Description: Use Wayland/labwc; false selects the single-app X11 fallback

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Container user ID; retain the existing value on upgrade

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Container group ID; retain the existing value on upgrade

Config.Name: Unraid Host
Config.Description: Used when creating the initial SSH configuration; existing config is preserved
